1170-3110-8164.easyPrerequisites:
"Soul Tether" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
Heartwood Crafter is prepared.
1170-3110-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

3257-5412-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Repeat.

2438-2946-4556-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2438-2946-4556-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4644-5711-7791.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Fanatic of Rhonas.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat.

1636-3943-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-3943-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Faldorn triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2060-2908-6930-7729.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {1}{U}.
Spider-Man India and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man India trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4478-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1824-2530-6747-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6747-7360.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1824-2530-6747-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

290-1978-7280.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Donatello.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

7-4477-7182.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Hamza.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2757-3459-4316-5078.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Battered Golem, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2523-3967-5401.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2079-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2079-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

333-4775-5147.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4775-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1379-5522-5747.description:
Cast Encroaching Mycosynth by paying {3}{U}.
When Encroaching Mycosynth enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability triggers, creating a 0/0 Contruct artifact creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
When the Essence of the Wild token enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability triggers, creating a 0/0 Contruct artifact creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Repeat step 3.
1379-5522-5747.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop at step 3 which will cause the game to end in a draw if it is not interacted with. It is highly recommend to somehow interact with the combo once you have achieved your desired result.

2034-4013-5790.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls more creatures than you.
2034-4013-5790.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Beza.
When Beza enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create two 1/1 Fish creature tokens, and a Treasure token if an opponent controls more lands than you.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Fish, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1849-2440-2703.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

372-2902-3742.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Journey to Nowhere to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Journey to Nowhere and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

2683-4166-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Footlight Fiend, adding {R}.
When Footlight Fiend dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Footlight Fiend on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Footlight Fiend trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, and exiling Footlight Fiend from the top of your library with the ability to play it until your end step.
Cast Footlight Fiend from exile by paying {B/R}.
Repeat.

659-2816-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Krenko.
659-2816-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
659-2816-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Krenko by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1984-2455-3454-4406.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{W} the first turn, with {12}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
1984-2455-3454-4406.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
1984-2455-3454-4406.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Chance for Glory and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chance for Glory, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Chance for Glory on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Chance for Glory triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.
